name: Ojou-sama wa Gakuen no Seieki Benjo ~Netorase・Bukkake・Rankou Seikatsu Nisshi~
original_name: お嬢様は学園の精液便所 ～寝取らせ・ぶっかけ・乱交生活日誌～
source:
The protagonist, Kuroi Kimihito, a senior student, is the boss of a prostitution ring on campus.
He assigns female students who are unable to resist because their secrets are known to them to teachers, some students, and influential people outside the school, thereby obtaining wealth and a guaranteed future.
The person who makes the protagonist the boss is
Reina Kareizawa, the daughter of a large company president.
One night two years ago, the protagonist ambushes Reina and rapes her,
obtaining a photograph of the incident, which he uses to submit her to the prostitution ring on campus, and
he has received the support of the men who flock to her body, which has brought him to his current position.
The protagonist has been forcing Reina to prostitute herself to influential people, solidifying his support, but
the anti-protagonist faction has begun to make a comeback.
Since she only has one partner per night, it seems that those who are impatient with waiting their turn are being drawn into the anti-protagonist faction.
The protagonist, who was forced to take urgent action to protect himself,
has Reina serve as a partner to more men and begins to secure new pawns.
translation:
主人公黑井君仁是高年级学生，也是校园卖淫团伙的头目。

他把掌握了秘密、无法反抗的女学生分配给教师、其他学生以及校外有权势的人，从中获得财富与有保障的未来。

让主人公成为头目的人，是大企业社长的女儿枯泽玲奈。
两年前的某夜，主人公伏击并强奸玲奈，拍下照片，以此将她纳入校园卖淫团伙。他还获得了那些觊觎她身体的男人的支持，最终坐上如今的位置。

主人公一直强迫玲奈卖淫给有权势的人，巩固自己的支持；然而，反主人公派系开始卷土重来。

由于玲奈每晚只能接待一名伙伴，那些不愿等待的人似乎加入了反主人公派系。被迫采取紧急行动保护自己，主人公让玲奈接待更多男人，开始确保获得新的棋子。
